title: The Garden Vowed at Dawn
intro: In the quiet hours before sunrise, a plan was made in secret. A flourishing inheritance stood ready for harvest, yet a resolve formed to keep every fruit away from those in need. By morning, everything would look unfamiliar, and a lesson would be etched into blackened branches for all who reflect.
clues: We inherited a flourishing garden and vowed to harvest all of its fruits for ourselves.
We swore to go out early at dawn while the poor who asked for their share were still asleep.
We excluded any exception from our oath and withheld the right of the needy without saying if Allah wills.
We went out whispering to one another to allow no poor person to enter our garden that day.
We imagined ourselves fully capable of gathering everything and preventing any gleaner from taking a portion.
We woke to find our garden ruined in the night, blackened as if harvested, and we said we were deprived and penitent.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Companions of the Trench
The Companions of the Garden
The Messengers of the Town in Surah Ya-Sin
The People of the Elephant
The Keepers of Hellfire

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Sacrificing a cow to resolve a murder dispute
Challenging a prophet to bring down stones from the sky
Plotting to harvest at dawn while denying the poor their share
Breaking the Sabbath by setting fishing nets
Building a dam to control floodwaters for trade
trial.answer: Plotting to harvest at dawn while denying the poor their share

location.label: Key Element
options: The sacred valley of Tuwa where fire was seen
The walled garden orchard to be reaped in the morning
The mirrored palace floor mistaken for water
The wooden ark built under divine instruction
The iron wall built between two mountains
location.answer: The walled garden orchard to be reaped in the morning

outcome.label: Outcome
options: We were turned into apes for transgressing the Sabbath
We slept in a cave for three hundred and nine years
We were swallowed by the earth with treasures for pride
Our garden was destroyed overnight and left blackened like night
We were drowned in the sea while pursuing the believers
outcome.answer: Our garden was destroyed overnight and left blackened like night

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
